# Data Source: catalyst_smarttrain_materials

List existing ConvoKraft SmartTrain material metadata for one bot in Development. Requires an explicit organization and `ZIAPlatform.Convokraft.RAG.READ`. The data source omits source URLs, material contents, and creator/modifier profiles. Verified offline against Zoho's full sample request path.

-> **Note:** This data source reads existing infrastructure. It does not create
or modify the service. Select the matching project, data center and environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    catalyst = {
      source = "edson-edwin/catalyst"
    }
  }
}

data "catalyst_smarttrain_materials" "existing" {
  project_id = "123456789"
  bot_id     = "234567890"
}

output "smarttrain_materials" {
  value = data.catalyst_smarttrain_materials.existing.materials
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Argument Reference

### Required

- `bot_id` (String) Existing developed ConvoKraft bot's positive numeric ID as a string.
- `project_id` (String) Existing Catalyst project's positive numeric ID as a string.

## Attribute Reference

- `materials` (Attributes List) Existing material metadata sorted lexicographically by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--materials))

<a id="nestedatt--materials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `materials`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Material ID as a precision-preserving string.
- `source` (String) Material source type, when reported.
- `status` (String) Training status, when reported.
- `title` (String) Material title, when reported.
